text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.18 for the AI Software Developer position. The strongest evidence for their application is a computer science degree and listed experience in "Machine Learning", "JavaScript", and "React". Key gaps include missing requirements for C#, SQL, .NET, TypeScript, containerisation, and NoSQL, as well as having less than two years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
